name: ubiquitin interaction motif containing 1

function.text: UIMC1 encodes BRCA1-A complex subunit RAP80. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-modified histone reader activity and histone binding. It participates in DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and regulation of DNA repair.
